name: Byl li u menja shans?
source:
Is there a way? - is a visual novel in which you will immerse yourself in the times of the USSR. You will have to reveal the details of your own story, find accomplices and solve the mysteries of the psychiatric hospital «Turov».

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2707710/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
有办法吗？- 是一部视觉小说，你将沉浸在苏联时代。你必须揭露自己故事的细节，找到同谋并解开“图罗夫”精神病院的谜团。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2707710/]Steam[/url]]
